get.description:
Consent text, per-hook data list and fingerprint for settings not yet saved.

``vision=true`` previews the consent with page images on (the vision reader
replaces PDF text suggestions). ``reader_strategy``/``primary_reader`` choose
the one vision provider; for the company server pass its model and base URL
(checked against the deployment allowlist).

post.description:
Save the credentials, record the accepted notice and queue the connection test.

The card is Not connected until the AI worker's test passes (poll
``GET /ai/requests/{id}`` and ``GET /ai/settings``). The key is write-only.

get.description:
The notice an admin accepts when connecting this provider, with its fingerprint.

For Gemini the notice depends on the declared key tier; a free-tier key's notice states
the data use explicitly. Nothing is written.

post.description: Delete the card's keys; a request still in flight is discarded, never applied.
Test a new key first; the old key stays active until the test passes.
Accept an uncertain (possibly billed) call; this allows exactly one new attempt.

get.description: Masked settings: the key itself is never returned, only a four-character hint.

Shadow reader aggregates: agreement labels per provider and field, latency and
failure codes. Never a value or a document.

post.description: Run bounded local fixtures; this endpoint never calls an external provider.
Queue one synthetic-fixture call; the AI worker sends it if the gate allows.

X-Session-Ended.description: Present when a supplied session cookie is no longer valid.
Present when a supplied session cookie is no longer valid.

get.description: Return the active immutable settings version and its ETag.

put.description: Append a validated configuration snapshot and atomically activate it.

409.description: The active configuration changed since it was read.

get.description: Advisory H1 or vision (page-image) suggestions, checked again; never applied here.

post.description: Confirm the listed current links of one document to one PO in a single transaction.

get.description: Return the seeded workspace catalogue used by the UI and exports.

post.description: Create a vendor by hand, e.g. an unregistered supplier without a GSTIN (AC-4).

patch.description: Set the vendor's display name; automatic resolution never replaces it.

get.description: Liveness check with no infrastructure or configuration detail.
Readiness checks PostgreSQL, migration head, object storage and a live worker.
